record.original_name: Thermally processed Curried Vegetables/Ready to Eat Vegetables
source_optional_ingredients: other ingredients suitable to the product
record.source_processing: heat processed appropriately before or after packing to prevent spoilage

non_inheritance_guards: Do not borrow 2.3.5 vegetable soup TSS 5% or tomato soup 7% as a mandatory 2.3.4 curried vegetable limit.
Do not borrow 2.3.3 vegetable 25/50/70% drained weight criteria for 2.3.4 without independent legally effective applicability.
The source 90% rigid-container fill is separate from net quantity, drained weight and commercial sterility.
The source has no numeric pH or lethality limit; actual thermal-process safety validation is required, particularly for low-acid RTE shelf-stable products.
Milk fat is expressly an optional ingredient; vegetarian/vegan and milk-allergen claims cannot be inferred from 'vegetables'.
An actual SKU can include pulses, legumes or cereals, so source identity alone cannot select a raw-vegetable CTR contaminant article.
Appendix B microbiology, applicable additives, actual pack/label, current effective Gazette, contaminants and validated analytical results remain unverified.
No manufacturer-specific product is approved and no commercial lot may be released by this audit.
